text: I stepped back from volunteering in community programs for a while because I felt unappreciated by lackluster participation. It became frustrating. I had poured my energy and resources into these initiatives, believing firmly in the transformative power of community involvement. However, when the turnout was consistently low, it felt like my efforts were falling into a void, never reaching the people they were intended to help. I started questioning whether my contributions truly made a difference, which weighed heavily on my motivation. Ultimately, the lack of enthusiasm from others took a toll on my spirit, prompting me to take a much-needed step back and reevaluate my priorities and the impact of my contributions.
